purpose: Top-100 co-expression partner list per curated-pool gene, for interaction_network_query in qa_generation/gt_functions.py.
why_this_exists: Track 4 (gene_pool_prep/compute_centrality_genes.py) computed the same correlations but persisted only in-degree counts; the top-100 partner sets were never written to disk.

methodology.correlation: Pearson across samples, blocked sgemm on z-scored columns
methodology.partner_universe: 21016 of 49231 QC-filtered columns — those whose symbol carries an in-vocabulary ENSG. Not restricted to the curated pool (Track 4 behaviour retained), but restricted to genes BulkFormer actually receives, per bulkformer_vocab_check.md.
methodology.partner_restriction_rationale: a co-expression partner outside the 20,010-gene vocabulary is a fact about a gene the model cannot see, so it cannot be a valid answer; standardization still spans all columns, so correlation values are unchanged
methodology.source_rows: 5797 curated-pool genes only (Track 4 used all 49231 columns as rows because in-degree needs every edge; QA only ever queries pool genes)
methodology.duplicate_symbol_columns: all columns carrying a pool symbol act as source rows; their partner sets are merged keeping the highest r per partner symbol
methodology.self_symbol_partners: excluded — subsumes Track 4's diagonal exclusion and drops the duplicate-column artifact edges its manifest flagged (n_same_symbol_edges = 6470)
methodology.tie_handling: ties on r resolved by partner symbol, ascending
